findings.title: Sponsor acceptance is not enough for reputation credit
findings.evidence: Settlement status is "sponsor-accepted-unfunded" and funded release evidence is missing.
findings.remediation: Hold badges, leaderboard points, and citation visibility until funded settlement evidence is attached.

findings.title: Appeal or hold window is still active
findings.remediation: Queue the reputation update as pending until appeal and hold windows close without unresolved disputes.

findings.title: Accepted scope does not cover all declared milestones
findings.evidence: Missing accepted milestone(s): reproducibility report; acceptanceScope=partial.
findings.remediation: Award only milestone-scoped credit or request explicit sponsor acceptance for the remaining deliverables.

findings.title: Team credit split is not supported by evidence
findings.evidence: 2 contributor split(s) differ by at least 20 percentage points; splitAgreementSigned=false.
findings.remediation: Require signed split agreement or allocate provisional credit using evidence-backed contribution shares.

findings.title: Requested reputation update overlaps prior claims
findings.evidence: Duplicate or overlapping claim ids: SYN-BOUNTY-REP-011.
findings.remediation: Deduplicate badge and point events before reputation ledgers or citation pages are updated.

findings.title: Scope changed after solver submission
findings.remediation: Normalize reputation credit to the scope active at submission time or attach sponsor-approved change evidence.

findings.title: Independent review is not complete
findings.evidence: External review is still pending while reputation points and badges are requested.
findings.remediation: Hold expert-tier badges until the external reviewer decision is final.

findings.title: Disputes or mutable scorecards can distort reputation
findings.remediation: Block leaderboard promotion until disputes close and the scorecard hash is frozen.

findings.title: Requested leaderboard tier is stronger than challenge difficulty
findings.remediation: Apply difficulty-normalized points and reserve top-tier badges for expert-level challenges.

recommendedLedgerAction: Keep reputation deltas pending until funded settlement, appeal closure, milestone parity, and evidence-backed team attribution are present.
